headline: Twelve holds the door on its spring.
body: The woman from the step is inside now, paper bag under one arm, still not looking up. A radio behind the counter starts the weather and then lets it go. We leave the hour marked as held, not hurried.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high pale, chimney line gone thin

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: flat on the pavement, gold spent

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one bag, door on its spring
